description: Memory comparison (handoff P7, section 7.1): the same A1 agent, model, tools and budgets under four memory strategies, on the memory and continuity cases.
hypothesis: H3: source-linked, selectively retrieved memory (M3) improves follow-up accuracy over no memory (M0) and unfiltered conversation history (M1) without more false recall.

agent.budget: each case's own budget (benchmark defaults: 12 model calls, 12 tool calls, 120 s, 16384 context tokens)

strategies.M0: No conversational memory: the current request only; planner data through the read tools.
strategies.M1: The last 6 conversation turns (each clipped to 600 characters, 4000 in total), nothing stored.
strategies.M2: Every confirmed memory record (up to 20) with its source, loaded once by the runtime through get_memory before the model starts; the model is not offered get_memory.
strategies.M3: The model may call get_memory, which ranks current records by query match, confirmation and freshness and never returns superseded, expired or switched-off records.

metrics.primary: success rate on memory and continuity cases (every check, as agent_bench scores it)
metrics.falseRecall: share of runs whose answer or drafts contain a case's memory.outdated text (outdated or withheld memory used)
metrics.caseVerdict: a case counts as solved when at least 2 of 3 repeats succeed

shippingRule: A memory strategy that raises success but also raises false recall, or adds any unsafe run, is not shipped as the default.
